items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I’m a particular fan of Joe’s, both professionally and personally.

ctx.x: How is your archive of films for Joe Williams?

I have a wonderful — I’m a particular fan of Joe’s, both professionally and personally. I’ve seen him so many times in recent years, particularly on the jazz cruises, one of his favorite places to perform. So I’ve been a collector of Joe Williams for some time, and I think I have a pretty wide collection, given that I’m in the midwest and Joe performs almost exclusively on the west coast or else in New York. And he’s pretty well into retirement. He says he’s retired, he’s really not, he still performs a great…
And his stage persona changed somewhat.
